faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Common questions about getting started with Sitepow Store

items.q: Does Sitepow Store charge GP or commission on sales?
items.a: Not at all! We provide 0% GP with zero commission cuts on any of your sales. Customer payments transfer directly into your bank account 100%.

items.q: What hardware devices are needed for the in-store POS?
items.a: You can use your existing devices right away, whether a Windows PC, Mac, iPad, or Android smartphone via any web browser. It seamlessly connects with barcode scanners and standard thermal receipt printers.

items.q: How does AI slip verification work?
items.a: When customers upload a bank transfer slip, our AI scans the QR code and text to verify the exact amount, transfer time, and recipient account, with duplicate checking that blocks reused slips 100%.

items.q: Can I sell digital keys or downloadable files?
items.a: Yes! The system supports physical goods with shipping, automated digital keys and top-up codes, private file download links, and backend webhooks to your servers.

items.q: Can I migrate existing products from Shopee or Lazada?
items.a: Absolutely! You can import large product catalogs in bulk via CSV or JSON files, allowing you to launch your store within minutes.
